                SELECT backend, COUNT(*) as cnt
                FROM execution_history
                GROUP BY backend ORDER BY cnt DESC
            ').fetchall

                SELECT nodes_used, COUNT(*) as cnt
                FROM execution_history
                GROUP BY nodes_used ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1
